description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

>若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the client token. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

description.zh:
诊断ID。

在您[DiagnoseVpnGateway](~~469751~~)调用接口时，系统会返回对应的诊断ID。
description.en:
The diagnostic ID.

The diagnostic ID is returned when you call the [DiagnoseVpnGateway](~~469751~~) operation.

description.zh:
VPN网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

title.zh: 查询VPN网关实例的一键诊断结果
title.en: Query the one-click diagnostic result of a VPN gateway instance

descriptions.zh: 调用**GetVpnGatewayDiagnoseResult**接口时，除必填参数外，**DiagnoseId**和**VpnGatewayId**参数需至少输入一个。
descriptions.en: When you call the **GetVpnGatewayDiagnoseResult** operation, you must specify at least one of the **DiagnoseId** and **VpnGatewayId** parameters in addition to the required parameters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc get-vpn-gateway-diagnose-result --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --diagnose-id vpndgn-uf6kuxbe3iv028k3s0000 --vpn-gateway-id vpn-uf6fzwp0ck3frwtbk0000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0010000 --region cn-hangzhou
